title: Fire Season: A Dry Wetland
blurb: Wildfire runs with the wind. Put it out and protect what matters.

events.title: A dry spell
events.text: Weeks without rain. The fire spreads one tile further this turn.

hints: Remove (2⚡) puts out a fire. A fire also burns itself out after two turns.
Protect (3⚡) makes a tile and the ring around it safe from fire for good. It costs more, so use it where fire keeps coming.
The arrows show where the fire goes next. Defend one tile in the way, or Protect the whole area.
realWorld: Follow local fire-danger rules and burn bans, and support or volunteer with your local fire service and land-restoration groups.
